name: CLUCK!
summary: In Westfall, a chicken may answer when you call and feed it. Follow its scratched message to the Saldean family, and a warm egg may be yours to hatch.

sections.title: A Strange Communion
sections.body: Ordinary chickens wander the farmsteads of Azeroth, and most travelers pass them by. Mimic a chicken's gestures and clucking, and it may stop pecking to regard you with interest. In that brief moment, the bird scratches letters in the dirt. The message points to the farmer who can provide the food it wants.

sections.title: The Farmer's Feed
sections.body: The bird's request calls for Special Chicken Feed. In Westfall, the Saldean family keeps this grain for their flock. Offer the feed and cheer the chicken on as it eats. In return, it lays a warm egg that can be nurtured into a feathered companion.

faq.q: How does a chicken offer a quest?
faq.answer: Mimic the chicken with repeated chicken calls or flapping gestures. Eventually, it pauses to inspect you and scratches a message in the dirt about its hunger.

faq.q: What does the chicken spell out in the dirt?
faq.answer: The chicken scratches out S-A-L-D-E-A-N in the soil. The name points you to Farmer Saldean and his wife at the Saldean Farm in central Westfall, where they sell the grain the bird wants.

faq.q: Where do you get the Special Chicken Feed?
faq.answer: Farmer Saldean stocks Special Chicken Feed at the Saldean Farm in Westfall.

faq.q: Can you do this with any chicken in the world?
faq.answer: Any ordinary barnyard chicken in settled lands can answer the gesture, though they are most often found around human farms such as those in Westfall.

faq.q: How do you complete the quest once you have the feed?
faq.answer: Carry Special Chicken Feed, find a chicken, and cheer it on. It accepts the feed and lays an egg beneath itself for you to collect.

faq.q: What do you get for finishing the quest?
faq.answer: The fed chicken lays a Farm Chicken Egg at its feet. Collecting it gives you a Chicken Egg that lets you summon a loyal Westfall chicken to follow you on your travels.

angles.text: The Saldean Farmstead in Westfall is where this odd chicken ritual takes place, making it a familiar tale among young Alliance adventurers exploring the battered rural kingdom.
The chicken's Special Chicken Feed can be eaten, though most cooks save the coarse grain for the birds.
